description: Hourly Consumption of Electric Mobility (Coimbra, Évora, Faro, Guarda and Leiria) is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). Este conjunto de dados apresenta informações sobre o consumo horário de energia elétrica associado à mobilidade elétrica (ME) em rede pública, segmentadas por distrito, concelho e freguesia. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consumption and Energy, Electric Mobility. Its keywords are internal. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
